queryResponseValue: admitted GraphQueryResponseV1 (schemaFamily opensip.product.query, schemaMajor 3), including context, items when required, optional nextCursor, optional termination. Not CommandEnvelope.query / QueryResult.

Retarget CommandEnvelope.query / QueryResult to GraphQueryResponseV1 (QueryResult.items is Uint53 count; GraphQueryResponseV1.items is a row array). That would be new envelope machinery.

Add a new public record type or readiness gate.

QueryResult.items is a count (Uint53), plus truncated/completenessMet/advisory. GraphQueryResponseV1.items is a row array. JSON already returns envelope plus a separate parity object.
surfaceConflicts.remedy: query-response lives in the host parity projection. Do not widen QueryResult. Residual: graph mapping into QueryResult.completenessMet/items-count is under-specified and is not required to adopt the parity-field change.

Equally small alternative: also drop truncated and total-items leftovers (more other17 human-line change). Prefer keeping them for other17 stability.
